news.title: Why Don’t Some People Use Chatbots?
news.summary_en: About half of U.S. adults never use chatbots, and most non-users cite disinterest, privacy or accuracy concerns.

news.title: French Adults Stand Out for Their Economic Pessimism
news.summary_en: Amid protests, 85% of French adults say their economy is bad, a higher share than in any of 17 other high-income countries surveyed.

news.title: Iran Conflict Remains Deeply Unpopular as Many Americans Expect It To Go On for Months
news.summary_en: Around two-thirds (65%) now disapprove of the way President Donald Trump is handling the U.S. military action in Iran, while a third (33%) approve.

news.title: Cost Concerns Dominate as Public’s Economic Ratings Turn More Negative
news.summary_en: The costs of many household essentials are a top economic concern for most Americans – much as they were four years ago on the eve of the last midterm election.

news.title: With Americans in a Sour Mood, Democratic Voters Are More Engaged in Midterms
news.summary_en: The 2026 midterm election comes amid deep public dissatisfaction with the state of the nation and near-record low approval ratings for Trump.

news.title: How Do Americans Engage With News Online?
news.summary_en: Most Americans chat privately about news online, but only about a quarter post publicly.

news.title: What Do Health and Wellness Influencers Post About?
news.summary_en: Just over half of health and wellness content on social media focuses on healthy living, while about a third discusses medical topics. And 38% of posts have a product or service promotion.
